title: Stacked bars
description: One column per point stacked by band from the baseline, blocks coloured by position from the categorical tokens with a 2px surface gap between them; muted points draw out of bounds. Each column owns its band of the width for hover, with a wash and a label pill.

anatomy.description: The root with data-slot="stacked-bars", role="img" and the per-column totals as its summary.
A group per point: hit rect over its band, hover wash, label pill and label; data-muted when out of bounds.
A visx BarStack group per band with --fill var(--juni-categorical-<index>) and --band; each block rect carries data-muted with its column.

usage: Takes the same bands and points as StackedArea; use bars for a handful of discrete periods (innings, quarters) and the area for a run of many.
A block shorter than the gap is not drawn, so a tiny share never shows as a hairline.
Keep hover in the caller: onHover reports the column's id or null; focus draws one column alone in colour.
